differences.title: 1. Primary Focus
differences.leftDesc: Debezium tails database transaction logs (e.g., binlog, WAL) to capture row-level changes as events, emitting them to Kafka.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Connect is a framework for streaming data between Kafka and other systems, using source/sink connectors.

differences.title: 2. Architecture
differences.leftDesc: Debezium is a distributed platform that uses Kafka as a message broker to stream database change events to consumers.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Connect runs as a distributed or standalone service, managing connector lifecycle and data processing.

differences.title: 3. Data Transformation
differences.leftDesc: Debezium emits raw change events with schema information, facilitating downstream schema evolution management and type mapping.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Connect offers Single Message Transforms (SMTs) for in-flight data manipulation before reaching Kafka or sinks.

differences.title: 4. Use Cases
differences.leftDesc: Ideal for creating event streams from databases for microservices, auditing, or real-time data warehousing.
differences.rightDesc: Used for building robust data pipelines, moving data from databases to data lakes, search indexes, or other Kafka topics.

differences.title: 5. Integration Depth
differences.leftDesc: Debezium provides deep, native integration with various databases by understanding their specific log formats and replication protocols.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Connect has a vast ecosystem of connectors for diverse sources and sinks beyond just databases.

differences.title: 6. State Management
differences.leftDesc: Debezium tracks its position within database transaction logs to ensure reliable event delivery and prevent data loss.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Connect manages offsets for its connectors, allowing for fault tolerance and restartability of data pipelines.

differences.title: 7. Operational Model
differences.leftDesc: Deploy and manage Debezium clusters specifically for capturing database changes, often as a microservice.
differences.rightDesc: Utilize Kafka Connect's worker processes to run and manage multiple connectors for various data integration tasks.
